slides.title: Tell me you're a property manager without telling me
Six vendors. Six COIs. Six different expiry months.
slides.body: And they all renew whenever they feel like it.

slides.title: The plumber's insurance lapsed in July.
slides.body: You found out today. While he was under the sink.

slides.title: Your filing system is a folder called "misc".
Retire the misc folder
slides.body: CertTrack tracks vendor COIs, licenses and permits and alerts you before they expire.
